records.name: Vue UInputNumber
records.purpose: Numeric text input with Intl.NumberFormat display, min/max/step clamping and ArrowUp/ArrowDown stepping.
records.surface: UInputNumber (Options API SFC InputNumber.vue, name "UInputNumber") and createBaseInputNumber (BaseInputNumber.ts) plus inputNumberStyleModule and InputNumberClassesParams (input-number-style.ts; neither style export is re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseInputNumber extends createBaseInput() (size, fluid, variant, resolvedVariant, resolvedFluid) over createBaseEditableHolder (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, filled, writeValue); because createBaseInput takes no arguments the factory shadows cx() and mounted(); mounted registers the style under the name inputnumber, which is also the Aura registry key, and is the only scoped base that passes additional preset keys (["inputtext"]) to registerComponentStyle. Declared props: locale, mode ("decimal", "currency" or "percent" are the only values the formatter maps; any other string behaves as decimal), currency, useGrouping (true), minFractionDigits, maxFractionDigits, min (null), max (null), step (1), allowEmpty (true), prefix, suffix, placeholder, readonly, disabled, invalid, name, plus inherited size, fluid, variant, modelValue and defaultValue. There is no inputId or aria-label prop, no showButtons or spin buttons, no slots and no v-model/defineModel declaration. Emits declared: focus, blur, input. focus and blur forward the native event; input carries { originalEvent, value } with the clamped value and is emitted by commit(), i.e. on every native input event and every ArrowUp/ArrowDown step; the native input event itself is not forwarded. update:modelValue and value-change come from writeValue(value, event) in commit(). Template: span root and one input type=text inputmode=decimal role="spinbutton" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow (numericValue ?? undefined) and aria-invalid (invalid || undefined); ref="input" is declared and never read ($refs is not used in this component). No UPortal, no overlay. Formatting: the formatter computed builds new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { useGrouping, minimumFractionDigits, maximumFractionDigits, style }) with currency (currency ?? "USD") only in currency mode; construction can throw during render (RangeError, for example minFractionDigits 5 with maxFractionDigits 2, an invalid locale tag or an invalid currency code); the TypeError that Intl raises for a currency style without a code cannot occur here because currency falls back to "USD". displayValue returns rawText while focused, "" for null or NaN, otherwise prefix + formatted + suffix. Note that percent mode does not scale: percent mode formats the stored number with style percent, so 0.5 shows 50% and 50 shows 5,000%, and parsing 50 stores 50. State: focused, rawText. On focus rawText becomes String(numericValue) ("" when null or NaN); while focused the shown text is rawText, so an external modelValue change while focused does not change the shown text (only typing or a step updates rawText). Parsing (parseValue): strips a leading prefix and trailing suffix, removes the group separator and maps the decimal separator to "." from formatter.formatToParts(1234.5) (fallbacks "," and "."), then removes everything outside [0-9.-]; "" and "-" give null, NaN gives null. Locale fact computed with Intl in plain Node: with useGrouping true (the prop default; the formatter receives the boolean true, which always emits a group, so es, it and sl report "." even though Intl's default 'auto' grouping with CLDR minimumGroupingDigits 2 prints 1234.5 as 1234,5), a locale whose formatToParts(1234.5) group is "." and decimal is "," (de, pt, pt-BR, nl, tr, es, es-AR, it, sl, da, ro, hr, el, id, vi, sr, ca, gl, eu and is among those tested) turns the focus text "1234.5" into 12345 and typed "1234.56" into 123456, because "." is removed as the group separator; locales whose group is not "." (en, fr, pl, ru and pt-PT among those tested) parse the focus text correctly. When useGrouping is false the formatter has no group part, the fallback group "," is stripped, and a typed decimal comma in any locale with decimal "," (de, fr, es, pt, it, pl, ru among those tested) is removed: "1,5" becomes 15. Exponent text: String(1e21) is "1e+21", which parses to 121 (the "e" and "+" are removed); String(1e-7) is "1e-7", which parses to null. Non-ASCII digits and a non-ASCII minus (such as the sv U+2212) are dropped by the same regex. Commit logic: clamp(min, max); null with allowEmpty false writes min ?? 0 to the model but still emits input with value null. onInput commits on every keystroke (a partial entry such as "-" writes null). Note that blur does not commit: onBlur only clears focused and emits blur, so no clamp or reformat is written on blur. Keyboard: onKeyDown returns early for readonly or disabled; ArrowUp/ArrowDown call preventDefault and spin(event, ±step); no Home, End, PageUp, PageDown or Enter. spin uses numericValue ?? 0 + delta clamped, with no rounding to fraction digits (0.1 + 0.2 is 0.30000000000000004), and a NaN numericValue stays NaN. onPaste only calls preventDefault for readonly or disabled; otherwise the browser pastes and the input event path runs. Model: when only defaultValue is passed (controlled is false) writeValue emits value-change only and never updates dValue, so the text after blur keeps showing the initial defaultValue instead of later input. Unused: the inherited size and variant props are never read; filled is never passed to a class resolver (InputNumberClassesParams.filled is declared and unused); invalid is applied through inputParams as p-invalid. Styles (input-number-style.ts, hand-ported, no @ultimate/uix-styles import, only a mention in a comment): classes root (u-input-number, u-input-number-fluid) and input (u-input-number-input, p-invalid); CSS tokens are dt('inputtext.…') (15 uses), the spin-button rules are intentionally excluded, no z-index and no overlay. Theme: Aura registry key inputnumber (value inputNumber), differing from the family name input-number. No component-metadata record exists. input-number.spec.ts and input-number.stories.ts are excluded supporting files. Composes no UPortal: no UPortal in this component.

records.name: Vue UDatePicker
records.purpose: Single-date picker: a readonly text input opens a portal calendar panel with month navigation and a day grid.
records.surface: UDatePicker (Options API SFC DatePicker.vue, name "UDatePicker") and createBaseDatePicker (BaseDatePicker.ts) plus datePickerStyleModule and DatePickerClassesParams (date-picker-style.ts; neither style export is re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseDatePicker extends createBaseInput() over createBaseEditableHolder; the factory shadows cx() and mounted() and registers the style under the name datepicker, which is also the Aura registry key. Declared props: placeholder, disabled, inputId, minDate (Date), maxDate (Date), disabledDates (array, typed readonly unknown[]), showIcon, showClear, dayNames (Su..Sa), monthNames (English names), appendTo ("body"), plus inherited size, fluid, variant, modelValue and defaultValue. Emits declared: select, clear, show, hide. select carries the bare Date (no originalEvent); clear, show and hide carry no payload. There are no slots and no v-model/defineModel declaration; writes use writeValue(value, event). Only a Date is accepted as the model: selectedDate is dValue instanceof Date, so any other model value is silently treated as empty. The initial view month and year come from defaultValue (else modelValue) when it is a Date, otherwise from today; today is captured once per mount (new Date() in data(), never refreshed). Display: the input is type=text readonly, so no typed entry; the text is the fixed MM/DD/YYYY format of formatDate (month and day zero-padded, year String(getFullYear()), no locale or format prop); an invalid Date shows NaN/NaN/NaN. Template: div root; input with id=inputId, tabindex, disabled, aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded; clear span (v-if showClear && filled && !disabled, aria-hidden, click only) and trigger span role=button aria-hidden (click only), so neither is keyboard operable; UPortal (appendTo) rendered only while overlayVisible, containing a panel div role="dialog" (no aria-label or aria-modal), a header with two buttons labelled "Previous month" and "Next month" and the month and year title, and a table role="grid" whose th cells use scope=col and whose cells are span role=gridcell with tabindex 0 only on the focused cell, aria-selected and aria-disabled. Grid: weeks is Sunday first (offset from getDay()), padded with previous and next month days to full rows of 7; cell keys are month-day-year; dayNames also act as v-for keys, so duplicate names would collide. isCellDisabled compares against stripTime(minDate)/stripTime(maxDate) and calls isSameDay(d, date) for every disabledDates entry, which calls d.getFullYear(), so a non-Date entry throws a TypeError during render. Cell click calls onDateSelect(cell) without an event, so writeValue receives no event; keydown on a cell passes the event. Years 0 to 99 map to 1900 to 1999 through new Date(year, month, day) (new Date(50, 0, 1) is 1950). Keyboard: on the input Enter, NumpadEnter and Space toggle with preventDefault and Escape hides when open (no ArrowDown open); on a cell ArrowRight/Left move ±1 day, ArrowDown/Up ±7 days (focusedCell moves even onto disabled or out-of-range dates and changes the viewed month), Enter/NumpadEnter/Space select, Escape hides; no Home, End, PageUp, PageDown or Tab handling. There is no .focus( call anywhere in the scope, so DOM focus never moves into the grid (roving tabindex only). There is no outside-click handler and the panel stays open when disabled becomes true (no watcher). hide() emits hide unconditionally (cell Escape and selection call it without checking overlayVisible). Model: when only defaultValue is passed (controlled is false) writeValue emits value-change only and dValue is never updated, so later selections are not displayed (only an initial defaultValue Date shows). Selecting a date in an adjacent month switches the view to that month. Styles (date-picker-style.ts, hand-ported, no @ultimate/uix-styles import, 26 dt('datepicker.…') uses): root classes u-date-picker u-component p-inputwrapper with p-disabled (no CSS rule for p-disabled in this module) and u-date-picker-fluid; day classes other-month, today, selected, focused and disabled (each has a rule: other-month and disabled use opacity 0.5, today, selected and focused set background, colour or box-shadow tokens, and disabled also sets cursor default); panel is position absolute with min-width 260px and no z-index. Theme: Aura registry key datepicker (value datePicker), differing from the family name date-picker. No component-metadata record exists. date-picker.spec.ts and date-picker.stories.ts are excluded supporting files. Composes UPortal.

records.name: Vue UColorPicker
records.purpose: Colour picker: a preview swatch opens a portal panel (or an inline panel replaces it) with a saturation/brightness square and a hue strip, driven by mouse and touch, producing hex (rrggbb), rgb or hsb values.
records.surface: UColorPicker (Options API SFC ColorPicker.vue, name "UColorPicker", inheritAttrs false) and createBaseColorPicker (BaseColorPicker.ts) plus colorPickerStyleModule, ColorPickerRootClassesParams, ColorPickerPreviewClassesParams and ColorPickerPanelClassesParams (color-picker-style.ts; none of the style exports is re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseColorPicker extends createBaseEditableHolder({ componentName: "colorpicker", styleModule }) directly, so it has no size, fluid or variant (it has no size, fluid or variant props); cx, style registration under colorpicker (also the Aura registry key), unstyled, per-instance dt and pt come from the shared base chain. Declared props: defaultColor ("ff0000"), inline, format ("hex" default; "rgb" and "hsb" supported, any other value behaves as hex), tabindex, autoZIndex (true), baseZIndex (0), appendTo ("body"), inputId, overlayClass, disabled, invalid, ariaLabel ("Select a color") and ariaLabelledby, plus inherited modelValue and defaultValue; PrimeVue's deprecated panelClass is not declared (ADR-104). Emits declared: change, show, hide. change carries { originalEvent, value, event }, where event is the same pointer event under PrimeVue's name; show is emitted when the panel starts to enter and hide when it starts to leave, with no payload. Value shapes: hex is written as "rrggbb" without "#", rgb as { r, g, b } (rounded) and hsb as { h, s, b }; hex is read with or without "#"; defaultColor is used only when the model is falsy. Math (PrimeVue's, replayed in plain Node): hexToRgb uses parseInt(hex, 16) with bit masks, so a 3-digit "#fff" becomes 0x0fff and yields { r: 0, g: 15, b: 255 }, an 8-digit hex gives a negative r (-256 for "#ff0000ff"), and invalid text gives NaN and { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0 }; rgbToHsb sets hsb.h = -1 for gray, black and white, which becomes h = 300 after the multiply and wrap, but toHsb then replaces the hue of any colour with s 0 or b 0 by localHue (0 before a hue is known) and otherwise stores the hue in localHue, and a pick in the square uses localHue as its hue; hsbToRgb rounds h, s and v first; validateHsb clamps h to 0-360 and s, b to 0-100. Template: div root (ref container) with cx('root', { inline, dragging }) and ptmi('root'); unless inline, an input type=text readonly (the preview swatch, inline backgroundColor, ref input) with id from inputId, aria-label "Select a color" by default, aria-labelledby, aria-haspopup="true", aria-expanded, tabindex and disabled; UPortal (appendTo; disabled when inline) wrapping a JS-driven transition (:css false; u-anchored-overlay through createMotionTransitionHooks) around the panel div (ref panel; always rendered when inline, otherwise only while overlayVisible) with cx('panel', { inline, disabled, invalid }) plus overlayClass, then content, a saturation/brightness square (mousedown and touchstart) with colorBackground and colorHandle, and a hue strip (mousedown and touchstart) with hueHandle; pt sections root, preview, panel (merged with overlay), content, colorSelector, colorBackground, colorHandle, hue and hueHandle. The panel, square and strip have no role, label or key handler, so the colour cannot be changed with the keyboard, as in PrimeVue source (ADR-104). Input keys: Space toggles with preventDefault; Escape and Tab set overlayVisible to false; Enter does not toggle; a click toggles unless disabled. Opening runs onOverlayEnter: it positions the panel with relativePosition (appendTo self) or absolutePosition against the input, binds a capture-phase document click outside-click listener that hides the panel for clicks outside the panel and the input, a ConnectedOverlayScrollHandler on the container that hides it on a scroll of any scrollable ancestor and a window resize listener that hides it on non-touch devices, sets the z-index through ZIndex under the overlay key (baseZIndex, else 1000) when autoZIndex, and emits show; leaving unbinds the three listeners and emits hide, and the z-index is cleared after leave. The panel stays open when disabled becomes true (no watcher on disabled). Drag: each press returns when disabled, ends any running drag and binds document listeners (mousemove and mouseup, or a non-passive touchmove plus touchend and touchcancel) that follow only the touch that started the drag, read getBoundingClientRect with 150 px constants, floor and clamping, and are removed when the drag ends; beforeUnmount also stops a running drag, unbinds the outside-click, resize and scroll listeners and clears the z-index. While a drag runs the root carries u-color-picker-dragging and the dValue watcher does not overwrite the colour; a format watcher re-converts the model. Model: updateModel sets hsbValue itself and then calls writeValue(value, event), so the swatch follows each pick. Styles (color-picker-style.ts): the CSS imports the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/colorpicker module (ADR-082, ADR-104) with dt('colorpicker.…') tokens and no z-index rule; classes root (u-color-picker-overlay unless inline, u-color-picker-dragging), preview (p-disabled), panel (u-color-picker-panel-inline, p-disabled, p-invalid), content, colorSelector, colorBackground, colorHandle, hue and hueHandle. Theme: Aura registry key colorpicker (value colorPicker), differing from the family name color-picker. No component-metadata record exists. color-picker.spec.ts and color-picker.stories.ts are excluded supporting files. Composes UPortal.

records.name: Vue UFileUpload
records.purpose: Inline file chooser and drop zone that validates selected files and uploads them with XMLHttpRequest or hands them to a custom handler.
records.surface: UFileUpload (Options API SFC FileUpload.vue, name "UFileUpload") and createBaseFileUpload (BaseFileUpload.ts) plus fileUploadStyleModule and FileUploadClassesParams (file-upload-style.ts; neither style export is re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseFileUpload extends createBaseComponent({ componentName "fileupload", styleModule }) only, so there is no modelValue, defaultValue, dValue or writeValue and no update:modelValue (no modelValue binding at all) and no size, fluid or variant; the factory also shadows cx() and declares mounted() with registerComponentStyle("fileupload"), the same name as the Aura registry key. Declared props: name ("files"), url, method ("POST"), multiple, accept, disabled, auto, withCredentials, maxFileSize, fileLimit, customUpload, chooseLabel, uploadLabel, cancelLabel, emptyMessage. Emits declared: select, progress, upload, error, clear, remove, upload-handler; payloads: select { originalEvent, files (incoming), currentFiles }, progress { originalEvent, progress }, upload { files }, error { files }, remove { originalEvent, file }, upload-handler { files }, clear none. No slots. Template: root div; header with choose button, then (v-if !auto) Upload and Cancel buttons, and a hidden input type=file (class display none); UProgressBar (imported by relative path ../progress-bar/ProgressBar.vue) while uploading with showValue false; message divs with no role or aria-live (no role or aria-live on validation messages); a drop zone with dragenter, dragover, dragleave and drop handlers; empty message; file rows (key name-size-index) with the formatted size and a remove button whose aria-label is the fixed English text "Remove file". No UPortal and no overlay. Validation (handleSelectedFiles): empty lists return; single mode starts from an empty list, multiple mode from the existing list; duplicates (name, type and size) are skipped; maxFileSize and accept failures add a message; fileLimit truncates the list; messages are replaced on each call; select is emitted even when every file was rejected; then the native input is cleared and, when auto is set and files exist, upload() runs. accept matching (isFileTypeValid): entries containing an asterisk compare file.type with the text before the first "/", so the pattern `*/*` (typeClass `*`) rejects every file because no type starts with "*", while a bare `*` has no "/" and its empty prefix accepts every file; other entries match the exact type or the extension case-insensitively. Dropping several files in single mode is ignored without a message; drag handlers return early when disabled. Upload (upload): returns silently without files, or without url unless customUpload; customUpload emits upload-handler and sends nothing; otherwise a FormData (field name) is sent with XMLHttpRequest, method, withCredentials and an upload progress listener that emits progress only when lengthComputable (Math.round(loaded*100/total)). Completion is handled only in onreadystatechange at readyState 4: a 2xx status emits upload with the files read at completion time, clears the list and messages, and emits clear; any other status, including status 0 for a network failure, emits error. There is no onerror, onabort or ontimeout handler and no abort: the XHR is not retained, so Cancel (clear) and remove do not abort an in-flight request; clear() during an upload empties the list, and the later completion reads the then-empty list. The Upload button is disabled while uploading and without files, but the Upload and Cancel buttons do not read the disabled prop (only the choose button, the hidden input and drag handlers do). formatSize: 0 gives "0 B"; each 1024 step moves through B/KB/MB/GB/TB with toFixed(2); sizes of 1024^5 bytes or more are not scaled past TB (1024^5 shows "1.00 TB"); fractional sizes below 1 give a negative index that falls back to "TB" (0.5 gives "512.00 TB") and negative sizes give "NaN TB". Styles (file-upload-style.ts, hand-ported, no @ultimate/uix-styles import): 13 dt('fileupload.…') uses plus dt('button.…') (button.border.radius, button.secondary.background) and dt('message.…') (message.error.background, message.error.color), i.e. it reads button and message theme tokens; classes root, header, chooseButton (disabled gives p-disabled), uploadButton, cancelButton, input, content (highlight gives u-file-upload-highlight), file, fileInfo, fileName, fileSize, fileRemoveButton, empty and message all used; FileUploadClassesParams.disabled and highlight are both read; the rule .u-file-upload .u-progress-bar sizes the child progress bar; no position or z-index. Theme: Aura registry key fileupload (value fileUpload), differing from the family name file-upload. No component-metadata record exists. file-upload.spec.ts and file-upload.stories.ts are excluded supporting files. Composes no UPortal: no UPortal in this component.
